description: Unit tests for HuffmanBuilder class, verifying Huffman coding properties and tree serialization.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.NoPrefixCollision
methods.description: Tests that no Huffman code is a prefix of another, ensuring prefix-free property.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.NoMissingInputs
methods.description: Ensures all used characters have representations and no extra representations are created.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.OptimalCodeOrder
methods.description: Checks that higher frequency characters have shorter or equal length Huffman codes.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.ToVector
methods.description: Verifies the serialized Huffman tree matches expected structure for a small example.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.ToVectorSingle
methods.description: Tests serialization when only a single character is used, ensuring a minimal tree.
